type_specific.meeting_summary: Arvada City Council held its September 1, 2026 business meeting, issuing proclamations for National Co-responder Week and National Service Dog Month before a lively public comment period focused on AI wildfire detection cameras and water meter privacy. The council split 4–3 to approve a $300,000 intergovernmental agreement funding a wildfire early detection system, with dissenters citing insufficient community engagement and unresolved data-ownership questions. The council also unanimously approved employment agreement amendments for three senior city officials on the consent agenda, and after extensive discussion approved a service plan for the Scenic Heights West Metropolitan District 7–0.
